gaps.lead: The film we saw last week was better than this one.
gaps.sentence: This film is not ___ the one we saw last week.
gaps.explanation: 'Not as good as' expresses an inferior comparison.

gaps.lead: He spoke so quietly that the jury couldn't hear him.
gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ for the jury to hear him.
gaps.explanation: so quietly that nobody could hear = too quietly (for anybody) to hear.

gaps.lead: Pay claims must be submitted before the end of the month.
gaps.sentence: You have ___ your pay claims before the end of the month.
gaps.explanation: 'Must be submitted' becomes 'you have to put in your claims'.

gaps.answer: can afford this holiday as long
gaps.lead: This holiday is within our price range, provided we don't go to the expensive restaurants in the tourist centre.
gaps.sentence: We ___ as we avoid the expensive restaurants in the tourist centre.
gaps.hint: provided = as long as; within our price range = can afford
gaps.explanation: 'Provided' is rewritten as 'as long as'; 'within our price range' as 'can afford'.

gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Couldn't go because of' → 'were prevented from going'.

gaps.lead: A mechanic repaired my father's roof last week.
gaps.explanation: have something done = arrange for somebody to do it: had his roof repaired.
